items.computation: Period starts from the letter's own date, 21.11.2026 (a Saturday), under §187 Abs. 1 BGB: the day of the event itself is not counted. The letter defines 'Werktage' as Monday to Saturday excluding public holidays. Counting forward from 21.11.2026 (excluding Sundays and public holidays): 23.11 (Mon, day1), 24.11 (Tue, 2), 25.11 (Wed, 3), 26.11 (Thu, 4), 27.11 (Fri, 5), 28.11 (Sat, 6), 29.11 Sun skipped, 30.11 (Mon, 7), 01.12 (Tue, 8), 02.12 (Wed, 9), 03.12 (Thu, 10), 04.12 (Fri, 11), 05.12 (Sat, 12), 06.12 Sun skipped, 07.12 (Mon, 13).
